battle.name: 郭子和起義
battle.brief: 大業十三年關中饑荒、隋廷失序，掖衛郭子和流放榆林後糾集亡命，殺同州郡丞王才、開倉賑饑，自立永樂王，建元正平，與梁師都及突厥往來，據渭北同州蒲城，與隋軍對峙逾年，翌年降唐拜雲州總管、封金河郡公。外彎單刃的月牙劍砍入不必拔刃，於密集結陣的近身搏鬥中可連劈不輟，正合流民結眾的肉搏戰法。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 大業十三年（617）的中原，交戰方是隋朝與郭子和起義的部眾。隋朝方面仍以長安為西京、洛陽為東都，但中央軍主力隨隋煬帝楊廣滯留江都，關中只餘長安留守府、與屯戍軍及郡縣官僚勉強維持秩序；同州一線以郡丞王才為地方軍政首長，榆林邊鎮則是戍卒、流刑犯與逃戶混居的駐軍與流民聚落，鎮戍空虛、巡察懈弛。郭子和一方則是臨時糾合起來的邊地部眾，以自立為永樂王的郭子和為最高首領，另設官屬與號令，既與關中另一支起義勢力梁師都往來，又向北求援於東突厥，被突厥封為平楊可汗，本人固辭不敢當，只受屋利設之號。這支部眾多由逃戶、流人、邊軍逃卒與本地鄉里豪強組成，作戰以散兵游騎為主，並無隋廷正式將領那樣的編制與糧秣供應。隋亡前夕，唐國公李淵在關中起兵入長安，郭子和旋即歸附唐朝，叛軍轉為唐朝的州縣官軍，衝突性質由叛逆變為編制收編；其後他與梁師都反目，又在唐軍序列內參與平定劉黑闥。整場衝突的戰場主體是陝西渭北的同州、蒲城一帶，榆林為起兵策源地，寧朔城則是後續爭奪的西北要點。
countriesEn: Throughout 617, the great year of the Sui collapse, the belligerents were the Sui dynasty on one side and the followers of Guo Zihe on the other. On the Sui side the state still had its western capital at Chang'an and its eastern capital at Luoyang, but the bulk of the imperial army had followed Emperor Yang Guang to Jiangdu, leaving Guanzhong with nothing more than the Chang'an garrison command, the regional and frontier troops, and the county magistrates to hold order. On the Tongzhou line the local military and civil authority rested with the Commandant of the Commandery, Wang Cai; the frontier town of Yulin was a mixed settlement of garrison soldiers, men sentenced to exile, and runaway households, its defences thin and its patrols slack. Guo's side was a hastily assembled body of frontier folk, headed by Guo Zihe himself, who had proclaimed himself Prince of Yongle, set up an administration and issued his own orders; he kept in touch with another Guanzhong rebellion led by Liang Shidu and looked north to the Eastern Turks, by whom he was granted the title of Pingyang Khagan — which he politely declined, accepting only the lesser title of Wulishi. His men were runaway households, exiles, deserters from the frontier garrisons and local village strongmen, fighting as loose irregulars and raiding cavalry, with none of the regular command structure or supply system of a Sui general. With the fall of the Sui and Li Yuan's entry into Chang'an, Guo Zihe promptly submitted; his rebel force was turned into the regular troops of Tang prefectures and counties, and the nature of the conflict changed from rebellion to absorption. Later he turned against Liang Shidu and fought as a Tang officer in the campaign against Liu Heitao. The heart of the fighting lay in Tongzhou and Pucheng on the north bank of the Wei in northern Shaanxi, with Yulin as the place of origin and Ningchuo as the later point of contention to the northwest.
people: 郭子和（？—664），隋朝左翊衛，隋末同州蒲城人，因犯罪被流放榆林，適逢關中饑荒，遂糾集地方士人與流亡，殺死同州郡丞王才，開倉賑饑，自立為永樂王，建元正平，尊其父為太公。他曾受梁師都拉攏，又獲東突厥封為平楊可汗而固辭不受，改封屋利設。618年唐朝建立後他歸順，被授雲州總管，封金河郡公，翌年改封郕國公；與梁師都交惡後出兵攻下寧朔城。武德七年（624）他隨秦王李世民平定劉黑闥，因戰陣奮勇獲賜姓李氏，封右武衛大將軍；唐太宗即位後加封食邑三百戶，顯慶元年（656）任黔州都督，以老乞骸骨，加金紫光祿大夫致仕，麟德九年（664）卒。父郭貴，仕唐為丹州刺史、上柱國；兄郭子政、郭子端、郭子升在亂時相與為難；子李道師後官至中散大夫、守安西大都護。其父被尊為太公，是仿漢高祖尊太公之例，用以表達自立為王的正當性。關中同時並起的多路首領梁師都，以及後來接納其降眾的李淵、李世民父子，是牽動這場起義歸宿的關鍵人物；至於起義時在榆林當地出謀劃策、真正替郭子和招納亡命者的具體人名，諸史僅存「地方士人」一語，具體名單不見記載。
peopleEn: Guo Zihe (?-664) was a Left Wing Guard officer of the Sui and a native of Pucheng in Tongzhou. Having committed a crime he was exiled to Yulin; when famine broke out in Guanzhong he gathered local men of substance and runaways, killed Wang Cai, the Commandant of the Commandery, opened the granaries to feed the people, proclaimed himself Prince of Yongle, set the era name Zhengping, and honoured his father as Taigong. He was courted by Liang Shidu and was granted the title of Pingyang Khagan by the Eastern Turks, which he refused, keeping only the title of Wulishi. When the Tang was founded in 618 he submitted, was made Commander of Yunzhou, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Jinhe, receiving the title Duke of Ying the following year; after falling out with Liang Shidu he took Ningchuo. In the seventh year of Wude (624) he followed Prince Qin, Li Shimin, in the campaign against Liu Heitao, and for his bravery in the battle was granted the surname Li and made General of the Right Martial Guard. Under Emperor Taizong he received an additional fief of three hundred households, and in the first year of Xianqing (656) was appointed Commandant of Qianzhou; he retired on grounds of age with the additional rank of Grand Master of the Golden Purple Splendour, and died in the ninth year of Linde (664). His father, Guo Gui, served the Tang as Chief of Danzhou and was raised to the rank of Upper Pillar General; his brothers Guo Zizheng, Guo Zhiduan and Guo Zisheng shared the trials of the time. His son Li Daoshi rose to Grand Master of the Palace and Protector General of the Western Regions. The elevation of his father as Taigong imitates the precedent of Emperor Gaozu of Han and was meant to assert the legitimacy of his own proclamation as king. Among the rebel leaders who rose at the same time in Guanzhong, Liang Shidu stands out, together with Li Yuan and Li Shimin, who later took over his surrendered men and decided the outcome of this rising; as for the specific men who planned the rising at Yulin and recruited the fugitives for him, the histories preserve only the phrase 'local men of substance' and give no names.
kits: 任務指定的兵器是埃及月牙劍（Khopesh），這件外彎單刃短劍出自埃及與敘利亞近東的青銅時代傳統，因砍入目標之後不必把劍身拔出，可連續揮劈而省去拔刃的動作，在密集隊形的近身搏鬥中格外有效。就功能對位而言，它與隋唐軍隊同樣倚重的環首刀一類單刃兵器屬於同一個技術家族，兩者都建立在「砍下去不回抽」的直刃砍劈邏輯之上；而真正決定這場衝突勝負的，是裝備數量、披甲比例、兵員訓練與糧秣供應，而非單件兵器的形制。隋軍裝備以環首刀、直刃長刀與長柄矛槊為骨幹，射手用小矢與臂弓，攻城則倚賴弩、撞車與拋石車，所發之石大如斗、重以百斤計（諸史記載略有出入），隋軍攻高句麗時曾以此破城垣；守城靠樓堞、穴地與雲梯互相反制。騎兵配兜鍪、兩當甲與扎甲，馬匹在榆林、同州之間的往來中佔重要地位。糧秣方面，起義靠開倉取粟與就地就食解決初期給養，歸唐之後才納入漕運與軍屯體系。與這件月牙劍同時存在於戰場的，還有大量冷兵器：金屬矛頭、木柄弓、藤盾、札甲與綿甲、皮甲、馬具、旌旗金鼓、帳幕車帳。由於唐初火藥武器尚未出現，戰場上沒有火砲、火箭或火藥，攻城全靠撞擊、投射與壕溝土木作業。
kitsEn: The weapon assigned to this card is the Egyptian khopesh, a short, outward-curved, single-edged sword from the Bronze Age tradition of Egypt and the Near East. Because it does not have to be pulled back out of the target after a cut, it can be swung again and again without the interruption of drawing, which makes it particularly effective in the close combat of tightly packed formations. Functionally it belongs to the same family as the ring-pommel dao, a single-edged blade of the type the Sui and Tang armies relied on; both are built on the logic of a straight-edged cut that is never reversed. What actually decided this conflict, however, was the sheer number of weapons, the proportion of armoured men, the training of the soldiers and the supply of grain — not the shape of any one piece of equipment. Sui arms were built around the ring-pommel dao, straight long swords and long-shafted spears; archers used light arrows and short bows; siege work relied on crossbows, battering rams and stone-throwers, the stones thrown weighing on the order of a hundred catties apiece (the histories differ slightly on the figure), and such engines were used against Goguryeo to breach city walls. Defence relied on wall-towers, sapping tunnels and scaling ladders. Cavalry wore helmets, two-part lamellar cuirasses and plated mail, and horses were of decisive importance in the movement between Yulin and Tongzhou. On the supply side, the rising drew on opened granaries and on eating where it stood during its first months, and was only drawn into the Tang system of river transport and military farming after its submission. Alongside the khopesh the battlefield held the usual cold arms: metal spearheads, wooden bows, rattan shields, lamellar and padded armour, leather armour, harness, banners, drums, tents and wagons. As gunpowder weapons did not yet exist in early Tang, there was no artillery, no fire-arrow and no powder on the field; sieges were won by ramming, by projection and by earthwork.
tactics: 起義的戰術起點在榆林邊地：隋朝邊鎮守備因主力西調、糧餉斷絕而空虛，戍卒逃散、流刑犯與逃戶聚居成聚，是最容易以「殺一官、開一倉」為號召的場所。郭子和先殺郡丞王才奪取地方權柄，隨即開倉賑饑取得部眾的生計支持，再聚眾萬餘、自建年號與名號，等於在隋廷的行政與賦稅體系之外另立一套徵召與供應。南下取同州、蒲城之後，他依托渭北黃河與洛水之險固守城池，以弩手居高拒守，以撞車與拋石對付隋朝來援的官軍，切斷關中漕運與洛陽方向的聯繫，同時分別與西面的梁師都、北面的東突厥保持往來，構成南北兩端的牽制，使隋廷在關中的處置無法集中兵力。斥候與遊騎負責監視河津、驛道與烽燧，阻斷消息傳遞。隋廷中央因煬帝遠在江都而無力增援，地方郡縣各自為守，起義得以延續逾年。歸唐之後，郭子和的部眾被拆編入州縣與禁軍體系，裝備收繳、旗幟改易，性質由流民武裝團轉為正規官軍；其後追隨秦王李世民討平劉黑闥時，所部作為騎步混編的力量參與河北戰場，於洺水之役隨主力渡水布陣、作戰奮勇，正是唐軍以少量精騎反覆衝擊破敵的一種戰法延續。
tacticsEn: The tactical starting point of the rising lay in the frontier town of Yulin. Sui frontier defences were hollow because the main garrison had been drawn west and the pay and grain had dried up, and soldiers had deserted, so exiles and runaway households gathered in clusters — the easiest place to rally a crowd under the cry of 'kill one official, open one granary'. Guo Zihe first killed Wang Cai, the Commandant of the Commandery, to seize local authority; he then opened the granaries to feed the people and win their livelihood; then he gathered more than ten thousand men, set up his own era name and titles, in effect standing up a second system of recruitment and supply outside the Sui administrative and fiscal order. After taking Tongzhou and Pucheng in the north he entrenched himself behind the Yellow River and the Luo River, held the walled towns with crossbowmen on the heights, met Sui relief columns with battering rams and stone-throwers, and cut the grain route and the road to Luoyang; at the same time he kept contact both with Liang Shidu to the west and with the Eastern Turks to the north, pinning the Sui in two directions so that it could never concentrate its force in Guanzhong. Scouts and raiding cavalry watched the river fords, the post roads and the beacon towers, and cut off the flow of reports. Central authority could send no reinforcements while the emperor sat at Jiangdu, and the prefectures and counties each defended themselves, so the rising lasted more than a year. After his submission to the Tang, Guo Zihe's men were broken up and absorbed into the prefectural and guard armies, their weapons taken in and their banners changed, and a body of armed refugees turned into regular soldiers; later, following Prince Qin Li Shimin against Liu Heitao, his mixed horse-and-foot force took part in the fighting in Hebei and, at the battle of Mingshui, deployed with the main body across the water and fought hard — a continuation of the Tang method of breaking an enemy with repeated charges by a small number of elite riders.
data: 大業十三年（617）是隋朝崩解前的關鍵年份：隋煬帝在位已逾十三年，兩度征高句麗耗盡府庫，五月李淵於涇陽起兵、十一月進入長安；同年關中大饑，《資治通鑑》記「米斗直三千錢」，洛陽一帶米價更高，軍糧與民食同時告急。郭子和聚眾萬餘，自立永樂王、建元正平，所控制的據點是同州蒲城，另有寧朔城於其後落入其手。隋朝全國同時存在多支起義軍：河北竇建德、江淮杜伏威、洛陽一帶李密、隴西薛舉、山西劉武周、陝西梁師都，時人稱十八家諸侯。地理上，榆林至蒲城直線約四百二十公里、近八百華里，實際行軍須繞行無定河與洛水河谷，故自策源至據守渭北耗時以月計；蒲城在同州城西北數十里，距長安約三百里上下（通行里程說），是關中東出洛陽的孔道之一。可考的年份：618年郭子和歸唐、拜雲州總管、封金河郡公，翌年封郕國公；武德七年（624）從李世民平劉黑闥，賜姓李，封右武衛大將軍；顯慶元年（656）授黔州都督；麟德九年（664）卒，生年史無明載，年壽不可考。起義的確切月份諸史未詳，通行說法繫於大業十三年秋冬之交。以上數字之中，兵力僅有「萬餘」一語可依，糧價與里程多據《資治通鑑》《舊唐書》通行記載；損失、俘獲與斬首數字史無記載，不予臆造。
dataEn: The thirteenth year of Daye (617) was the critical year before the Sui fell apart. Yang Guang had ruled for more than thirteen years, his two campaigns against Goguryeo had drained the treasury, in May Li Yuan rose at Jingyang and in November entered Chang'an; in the same year Guanzhong was struck by great famine, and the Zizhi Tongjian records that a dou of rice fetched three thousand cash, with prices in the Luoyang region even higher, so that army grain and household food failed at the same time. Guo Zihe gathered more than ten thousand men, proclaimed himself Prince of Yongle and set the era Zhengping; the stronghold he held was Pucheng in Tongzhou, and Ningchuo fell to him later. Across the Sui realm there were by now many rebel armies at once: Dou Jiande in Hebei, Du Fuwei in the Jianghuai, Li Mi around Luoyang, Xue Ju in Longxi, Liu Wuzhou in Shanxi and Liang Shidu in Shaanxi, collectively called the eighteen lords. Geographically, Yulin to Pucheng is about 420 kilometres as the crow flies, nearly eight hundred li, and an actual march has to follow the valleys of the Wuding and Luo rivers, so the rising took months to travel from its place of origin to the north bank of the Wei; Pucheng lies some tens of li north-west of the Tongzhou city and about three hundred li from Chang'an (the usual figure given for the post road), and it guards one of the main routes east from Guanzhong to Luoyang. The datable points are: in 618 Guo Zihe submitted to the Tang, was made Commander of Yunzhou and enfeoffed as Duke of Jinhe; the following year he became Duke of Ying; in the seventh year of Wude (624) he followed Li Shimin against Liu Heitao, was granted the surname Li and made General of the Right Martial Guard; in the first year of Xianqing (656) he was appointed Commandant of Qianzhou; he died in the ninth year of Linde (664), his birth year not recorded and his age therefore unknown. The exact month of the rising is not given in the histories, though it is commonly placed in the autumn-to-winter of the thirteenth year of Daye. Of the figures above, the only one that can be leaned on for strength is the phrase 'more than ten thousand'; the grain price and the distances follow the standard readings of the Zizhi Tongjian and the Jiu Tangshu. Figures for losses, captures and heads taken are not recorded in the histories and are not invented here.
cause: 起義的直接起因是關中饑荒與隋廷秩序的崩解。大業十三年前後，連年水旱與戰事使關中倉廩空虛，米價騰至斗直三千錢，饑民成群逃荒；榆林一帶又聚了大量被判流刑的罪人與逃戶，邊鎮守軍缺糧缺兵，巡察與鎮壓的力量幾近於無。隋煬帝楊廣自三征高句麗之後已把大量精兵與錢糧耗在東北與江都，自大業七年起多次巡遊江都，政令久不出京師，關中只剩長安留守府與郡縣自行其是，民間於是普遍相信朝廷已無力再收拾局面。外因方面，劉武周、薛舉、梁師都等同類起義已在西北與北方成軍，提供了可見的樣板；北方的東突厥亦有意拉攏中原亂勢以牽制隋朝，願意以汗號封賞新附的勢力。個人層面上，郭子和本為左翊衛，犯罪被流放榆林，身份從正軍將校淪為邊地刑徒，正是在這種處境下他得以脫離原有軍籍，憑個人威望與鄉里關係號召部眾。而隋朝對地方叛亂的處理，向來只倚靠郡兵與附近鎮軍，缺少能統合關中諸部、迅速掃平的一次性兵力部署，於是地方首領得以各據一方、各自擴張。諸說並存之處，在於起義究竟先由流人策動，還是由鄉里豪強主導；《資治通鑑》與新、舊唐書多採後者，記其「聚地方士人」而後舉事。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the rising was the famine in Guanzhong and the breakdown of Sui order. Around the thirteenth year of Daye, successive floods, droughts and wars had emptied the granaries of Guanzhong, the price of rice had risen to three thousand cash a dou, and hungry households fled in bands. The region of Yulin also held a large concentration of men sentenced to exile and of runaway households; the frontier garrisons lacked both pay and food, and the power of the prefectures to patrol and put down disorder had all but vanished. Yang Guang, having spent the great mass of his soldiers, money and grain on Goguryeo in the north-east and on Jiangdu, had made repeated tours of Jiangdu from the seventh year of Daye; his orders no longer left the capital, and in Guanzhong only the Chang'an garrison command and the prefectures and counties governed themselves, so that the common people generally believed the court had no strength left to set matters straight. As external causes, risings of the same kind had already formed armies in the north-west and the north under Liu Wuzhou, Xue Ju and Liang Shidu, and offered a visible model; the Eastern Turks to the north were also keen to enlist the disorder of the central plains as a means of pressuring the Sui, and were willing to reward new clients with titles in the khanate. On the personal level, Guo Zihe had been an officer of the Left Wing Guard; convicted of an offence he was exiled to Yulin, and there, reduced from a regular officer to a frontier convict, he was in a position to leave the old military register behind and rally followers on the strength of his own standing and his ties to the local families. And because the Sui habitually handled local revolts with prefectural troops and nearby garrison detachments alone, without a single deployment capable of combining the several rebel bands in Guanzhong and sweeping them away quickly, local leaders were able each to hold their own ground and expand. Where accounts differ is in whether the rising was first stirred by exiles or by local village strongmen; the Zizhi Tongjian and the New and Old Tang histories mostly take the latter view, recording that he 'gathered local men of substance' before raising his banner.
impact: 這場起義本身的軍事規模不大，卻產生了幾項超出戰役本身的後果。其一，它在隋朝統治最脆弱的關中腹心撕開缺口，令同州、蒲城一帶脫離朝廷掌控，切斷關中通往洛陽的漕運與驛道，直接削弱了隋朝最後的西面支撐，加速中央權威在關中的解體。其二，郭子和以開倉賑饑取得部眾、以受封突厥汗號取得邊外部勢支持、又在形勢轉變時向唐輸誠，示範了一條地方武裝集團在王朝更替中的典型出路：先據城自立，再擇強者而附，改旗易幟、由叛軍轉為官軍，部眾與器械由私收轉為官收。這條路後來在唐初吸納各地起義殘部、降將與地方豪強時被反覆沿用，成為隋唐之際軍頭化為州縣將吏的制度路徑之一。其三，他與梁師都反目並攻取寧朔城，切斷了關中另一支起義勢力與北方突厥的聯繫，為唐太宗貞觀年間最終消滅梁師都鋪平了道路。其四，就家族史而言，郭氏一系自起義首領轉為唐室將門，其子李道師官至安西大都護，說明歸附確實帶來了世代晉升的實際好處；這對後來北方邊鎮出身的軍人如何在新王朝中取得位勢，具有示範意味。戰術層面上，這場衝突也再次印證了唐代邊鎮流民社會的結構性隱患：流刑犯、逃戶與戍卒集中在北方邊地，既是亂源，也是唐初邊軍的兵源。
impactEn: The military scale of this rising was not large, yet it produced consequences that reached beyond the campaign itself. First, it tore a breach in the heart of Guanzhong, the most fragile part of Sui control, took Tongzhou and Pucheng out of the court's hands, cut the grain route and the post road from Guanzhong to Luoyang, and so directly weakened the last western support of the Sui, accelerating the dissolution of central authority in the region. Second, Guo Zihe demonstrated a typical route for an armed local group in a dynastic transition: win support by opening the granaries, win external backing by accepting a Turkic title, and then, when the situation turned, offer submission to the Tang — first hold a city and proclaim oneself, then attach to whichever power was rising, change the banners, turn a rebel band into official troops, and have the men and the weapons go from private hands into state hands. That route was used again and again as the early Tang absorbed the remnants of the various risings, surrendered generals and local strongmen, and it became one of the institutional paths by which military leaders became prefectural and county officers across the Sui-Tang transition. Third, his quarrel with Liang Shidu and the capture of Ningchuo cut off another rebel power in Guanzhong from its support in the northern Turks, paving the way for the final destruction of Liang Shidu under Emperor Taizong in the Zhenguan era. Fourth, in family history, the Guo line went from rebel leader to Tang military clan, the son Li Daoshi reaching the post of Protector General of the Western Regions, which shows that submission brought real and lasting advancement across generations; that was a meaningful example for how men from the northern frontier towns would make their way in the new dynasty. At the tactical level, the conflict once again confirmed the structural weakness of the frontier floating-settlement society of the Tang: exiles, runaway households and deserters concentrated in the northern border, at once a source of disorder and the recruiting ground of the early Tang border armies.
result: 起義最終以和平收編收場，而不是被隋軍殲滅。大業十三年秋冬，郭子和在榆林起兵，殺同州郡丞王才，開倉賑饑，聚眾萬餘，自立為永樂王並建元正平，控制同州、蒲城等渭北據點，與隋朝官軍對峙一年有餘；期間他一方面受梁師都拉攏，另一方面獲東突厥封為平楊可汗而固辭不受，只留屋利設之號，並利用渭北地勢與河北方向的聯繫拖住隋廷的處置。618年李淵建唐、長安易主之後，隋朝旋即崩潰，郭子和見時勢已去，遂歸降唐朝，被授雲州總管、封金河郡公，翌年進封郕國公，部眾由起義軍改編為州縣與禁軍序列，裝備旗幟一律收換。其後他與昔日的盟友梁師都反目，出兵攻下寧朔城，斷其外援；武德七年隨秦王李世民征討劉黑闥，因陣前奮勇獲賜姓李氏，封右武衛大將軍，太宗即位後加封食邑三百戶，顯慶元年出為黔州都督，以年老致仕，加金紫光祿大夫，麟德九年卒於官。這場起義沒有直接推翻隋朝，但它是關中反隋諸軍中較早建立政權、並且成功轉化為新王朝軍政骨幹的一支；隋朝真正的終結者是關中的李淵與河北的竇建德，而郭子和的歸附，構成隋亡之後唐室吸納地方武力的第一批樣本之一。
resultEn: In the end the rising was settled by peaceful absorption rather than destroyed by a Sui army. In the autumn and winter of the thirteenth year of Daye, Guo Zihe rose at Yulin, killed Wang Cai, the Commandant of the Commandery, opened the granaries to feed the people, gathered more than ten thousand men, proclaimed himself Prince of Yongle, set the era Zhengping, took Pucheng and other strongholds on the north bank of the Wei, and stood off against Sui columns for more than a year. During that time he was courted by Liang Shidu, was granted the title of Pingyang Khagan by the Eastern Turks but declined it, keeping only the title of Wulishi, and used his ground on the north bank of the Wei together with his contacts to the north and west to tie down the Sui's disposition of forces. In 618, after Li Yuan founded the Tang and Chang'an changed hands, the Sui collapsed at once; seeing the turn of the situation, Guo Zihe submitted to the Tang, was made Commander of Yunzhou and enfeoffed as Duke of Jinhe, and the next year was advanced to Duke of Ying. His men were converted from a rebel army into the prefectural and guard formations, their weapons and banners all changed over. He then quarrelled with his former ally Liang Shidu and took Ningchuo, cutting off his support; in the seventh year of Wude he followed Prince Qin Li Shimin against Liu Heitao, and for his gallantry in the field was granted the surname Li and made General of the Right Martial Guard. Under Taizong he received an additional fief of three hundred households, in the first year of Xianqing he was sent out as Commandant of Qianzhou, and he retired on grounds of age with the additional rank of Grand Master of the Golden Purple Splendour, dying in office in the ninth year of Linde. This rising did not by itself overthrow the Sui, but among the anti-Sui bands in Guanzhong it was one of the earliest to set up a polity of its own and one of the most successful at turning itself into the military backbone of the new dynasty. It was Li Yuan in Guanzhong and Dou Jiande in Hebei who truly ended the Sui, and Guo Zihe's submission stands as one of the first models of the way the Tang absorbed local armed strength after the dynasty's fall.
